highlights.title: Finalize pump events and record scheduled basal
changes: Pump doses now finalize with actual delivered amounts instead of keeping only the initial command.
Gaps with no pump reports are filled by recorded scheduled-basal rows so the app tracks expected basal delivery.
Scheduled-basal rows are excluded from command inputs and are not uploaded to Nightscout/Health/Tidepool.
Temporary in-flight (mutable) doses update in place until finalized, and uploads send finalized doses only.
TDD totals and the basal chart use recorded delivered values and consume scheduled-basal rows where present.

sources.title: nightscout/Trio#1300: Finalized Pump Events and Infer Scheduled Basal In-Memory

includedPullRequests.title: Finalized Pump Events and Infer Scheduled Basal In-Memory
includedPullRequests.body:
## Summary

Adopts LoopKit's dose lifecycle for pump event storage and records scheduled basal delivery instead of inferring it per consumer. Scheduled basal rates (SBRs) are kept mostly for Trio-internal convenience.

  - **Upsert by dose `syncIdentifier`**: mutable (in-flight) events update in place; finalized reports freeze rows with actual `deliveredUnits` and run times. Previously we kept the commanded first report and dropped the finalized one. Also fixes same-timestamp bolus+TBR shadowing in dedup.
  - **Adopt `replacePendingEvents`**: unasserted mutable rows are revoked (LoopKit `DoseStore` semantics); this should avoid any orphaned doses. Uploads (NS/Health/Tidepool) now send finalized rows only, once.
  - **Scheduled basal recorded** (`isScheduledBasal`): a reconciler fills reporting gaps (open loop, connectivity loss, TBR expiry) from the basal schedule each loop tick; pump-reported data always wins and overlapping synthetic rows self-heal.
  - **Consumers**: TDD sums recorded rows and `deliveredUnits` (inference removed); chart plots SBR segments at reduced opacity; oref input and `currentTemp` intentionally exclude them (commands only); NS is not uploaded SBR rows.

**Migration:** additive optional attributes, lightweight (verified on a populated store with ~1k records of existing pump data). Legacy rows count as finalized, non-scheduled. Verified on pump+CGM sim: mutable and subsequent finalized on same row, 5.7h gap backfilled at schedule rates, TDD/chart/loop work / plot nominally with SBR rows present.

Follow-ups / Left-over TODOs: 
* Health/Tidepool pseudo-event consolidation
* Potentially address open-suspend at 24h look-back boundary (fetch 24 hrs of data, excluding suspend event)
